findings.passage: On April 7th, I saw our young people, our elders, our fathers – our mothers standing in long lines block after block waiting to cast their vote.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name when she co-sponsored a bill for a vote-by-mail system for the rest of the 2020 elections. It is about access to voting by mail, not ID. Release is from spring 2020 (it refers to the April 7 election); exact day not shown.

findings.passage: We do not know how many new cases will be reported as a result of Tuesday’s exercise in voter suppression – especially in underserved communities across the state of Wisconsin.
findings.note: Same release. She calls the April 7, 2020 in-person election an exercise in voter suppression and backs mail voting. Related to ballot access; it does not mention ID.
